# CARC Documentation

> User and researcher documentation for the UNM Center for Advanced Research Computing (CARC): high-performance computing, storage, software, tutorials, and training. The source repository is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle: every page carries YAML frontmatter with type, provenance (generated/sources), and lifecycle (status/stale_after) fields.

Every page below is listed with three addresses that all return the same content: the rendered HTML page, its Markdown twin (page URL + `index.md`, served as text/markdown with the OKF frontmatter), and the raw source file on GitHub. Fetch whichever your tool is allowed to reach; many sandboxes permit github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com but not every documentation host.

```
Site page        https://carc.unm.edu/docs/<path>/
Markdown twin    https://carc.unm.edu/docs/<path>/index.md
Raw source       https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/<path>.md      (branch main; a moving target)

Content page     /running-jobs/slurm-intro/  ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/slurm-intro.md
Section listing  /running-jobs/              ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/index.md
```

## Getting started

- [Getting started at CARC](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/overview/): Create a CARC account, join a project in ColdFront, and find support. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/overview/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/overview.md
- [Good Neighbor Use Policy](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/good-neighbor-policy/): Acceptable-use rules that all CARC users agree to: account sharing, data restrictions, job monitoring, and security. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/good-neighbor-policy/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/good-neighbor-policy.md
- [Logging in to CARC systems](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/logging-in/): Connect to CARC clusters with SSH from Linux, macOS, or Windows. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/logging-in/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/logging-in.md
- [Password reset and one-time passwords](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/password-reset/): Reset your CARC password and manage one-time-password (OTP) settings. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/password-reset/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/password-reset.md
- [SSH keys and client configuration](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/ssh-keys/): Generate SSH key pairs and configure your SSH client for convenient, secure logins. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/ssh-keys/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/ssh-keys.md
- [X11 forwarding](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/x11-forwarding/): Display graphical applications from CARC machines on your local screen with X11 forwarding. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/x11-forwarding/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/x11-forwarding.md
- [Transferring data](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/transferring-data/): Move data to and from CARC systems with scp, rsync, sftp, and Globus. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/transferring-data/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/transferring-data.md
- [Introduction to Linux](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/linux-intro/): A first tour of the Linux command line for new HPC users. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/linux-intro/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/linux-intro.md
- [Learning Linux resources](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/learning-linux/): Curated external resources for learning the Linux command line. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/getting-started/learning-linux/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/getting-started/learning-linux.md

## Systems & storage

- [Systems overview](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/overview/): Current CARC clusters (Easley and Hopper), storage tiers, and web portals such as JupyterHub, Open OnDemand, and XDMoD. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/overview/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/systems/overview.md
- [Storage and compute usage policies](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/resource-limits/): Storage quotas, per-cluster partition and walltime limits, Slurm fairshare policy, and the job time-limit extension policy. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/resource-limits/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/systems/resource-limits.md
- [Storage and backups](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/storage/): CARC storage spaces (home, project, scratch), the real filesystem paths, retention windows, and what is backed up. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/storage/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/systems/storage.md
- [Storage permissions on BeeGFS](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/storage-permissions/): Manage file and directory permissions, including ACLs, on CARC BeeGFS scratch storage. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/storage-permissions/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/systems/storage-permissions.md
- [Cluster specifications (legacy reference)](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/cluster-specifications/): Historical hardware tables for CARC clusters, including retired systems such as Wheeler, Taos, Gibbs, and Xena. (deprecated; kept for history) Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/systems/cluster-specifications/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/systems/cluster-specifications.md

## Running jobs

- [Introduction to Slurm](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-intro/): Slurm basics on CARC clusters: partitions, interactive jobs, and your first batch script. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-intro/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/slurm-intro.md
- [Submitting jobs](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/submitting-jobs/): Submit, monitor, and cancel batch and interactive jobs with Slurm. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/submitting-jobs/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/submitting-jobs.md
- [Slurm command reference](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-reference/): Common Slurm commands and sbatch directives with examples. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-reference/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/slurm-reference.md
- [Example Slurm scripts](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/example-slurm-scripts/): Ready-to-adapt sbatch scripts for serial, parallel, and GPU jobs. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/example-slurm-scripts/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/example-slurm-scripts.md
- [Slurm accounting and fairshare](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-accounting/): How Slurm accounts, job accounting, and the fairshare system work at CARC. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/slurm-accounting/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/slurm-accounting.md
- [PBS to Slurm migration](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/pbs-to-slurm/): Translate PBS/Torque commands and scripts to their Slurm equivalents. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/pbs-to-slurm/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/pbs-to-slurm.md
- [Environment modules](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/modules/): Find, load, and manage software with environment modules on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/modules/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/modules.md
- [GNU Parallel](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/gnu-parallel/): Run many small tasks efficiently inside a single Slurm job with GNU Parallel. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/running-jobs/gnu-parallel/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/running-jobs/gnu-parallel.md

- [Open OnDemand](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/interactive/open-ondemand/): Use CARC clusters from your browser: files, shells, job management, and interactive apps. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/interactive/open-ondemand/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/interactive/open-ondemand.md
- [JupyterHub](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/interactive/jupyterhub/): Run Jupyter notebooks on Hopper and Easley compute nodes through CARC JupyterHub. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/interactive/jupyterhub/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/interactive/jupyterhub.md

## Software

### Python & Jupyter

- [Conda and Anaconda: introduction](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-intro/): What conda is, how environments work, and how to use Anaconda/Miniconda on CARC systems. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-intro/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/conda-intro.md
- [Managing conda environments](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-environments/): Create, activate, export, and remove conda environments on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-environments/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/conda-environments.md
- [Conda channels and pip](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-channels-pip/): Use conda channels (conda-forge, bioconda) and mix pip installs safely inside environments. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-channels-pip/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/conda-channels-pip.md
- [Conda environments in JupyterHub](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-jupyterhub/): Make your conda environments available as kernels in CARC JupyterHub. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/conda-jupyterhub/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/conda-jupyterhub.md
- [Installing deep learning packages](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/deep-learning-packages/): Install GPU-enabled deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) into conda environments. (draft) Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/deep-learning-packages/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/deep-learning-packages.md
- [Parallel Python with Dask and scikit-learn](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/dask-scikit-learn/): Scale scikit-learn workloads across cluster nodes from JupyterHub using Dask. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/dask-scikit-learn/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/dask-scikit-learn.md
- [MPI parallelization from JupyterHub](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/jupyterhub-mpi/): Run MPI-parallel Python (mpi4py/ipyparallel) from CARC JupyterHub sessions. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/jupyterhub-mpi/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/jupyterhub-mpi.md
- [Julia in JupyterHub](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/julia-jupyterhub/): Register a Julia kernel and use Julia notebooks in CARC JupyterHub. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/julia-jupyterhub/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/software/julia-jupyterhub.md

- [R batch jobs with PBS (retired)](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/software/r-pbs-jobs/): Historical instructions for submitting R jobs with PBS/Torque, which CARC has replaced with Slurm. ## Tutorials

- [Variant calling with GATK](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/gatk/): A genomics variant-calling workflow using GATK best practices on CARC systems. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/gatk/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/gatk.md

Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/metabarcoding/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/metabarcoding.md
- [RAD-seq analysis with Stacks](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/stacks/): Analyze restriction-site associated DNA sequencing (RAD-seq) data with Stacks. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/stacks/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/stacks.md
- [Genome assembly evaluation with QUAST and BUSCO](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/genome-evaluation/): Evaluate genome assembly quality and completeness with QUAST and BUSCO. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/genome-evaluation/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/genome-evaluation.md
- [Coalescent simulation with msprime](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/msprime/): Simulate genealogical histories and genome sequences with msprime. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/msprime/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/msprime.md
- [Demographic inference with PSMC](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/psmc/): Infer population size history from diploid genomes using PSMC. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/psmc/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/psmc.md
- [Bayesian phylogenetics with BEAST](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/beast/): Run BEAST Bayesian evolutionary analyses on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/beast/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/beast.md
- [SimCov epidemiological simulation](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/simcov/): Run the SimCov agent-based model of SARS-CoV-2 infection dynamics in lung tissue. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/simcov/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/simcov.md
- [VASP materials simulation](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/vasp/): Set up and run VASP density-functional-theory calculations on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/vasp/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/vasp.md
- [ORCA quantum chemistry](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/orca/): Run ORCA quantum chemistry calculations in parallel on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/orca/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/orca.md
- [Parallel CASA for radio astronomy](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/mpi-casa/): Run mpiCASA for parallel radio astronomy imaging on CARC clusters. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/tutorials/mpi-casa/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/tutorials/mpi-casa.md

## Support

- [Getting help](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/support/help/): Open a help ticket, email CARC support, or drop into office and consultation hours. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/support/help/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/support/help.md
- [Acknowledging CARC](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/support/acknowledging-carc/): The acknowledgement statement to include in publications that used CARC resources. ## About

- [Mission and vision](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/mission/): CARC's vision and mission: leading and growing the computational research community at UNM. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/mission/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/about/mission.md
- [Facilities description](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/facilities/): Boilerplate facilities description for grant proposals: clusters, storage, networking, and the data center. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/facilities/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/about/facilities.md
- [Partner cyberinfrastructure](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/partners/): National and regional platforms CARC users can reach: ACCESS-CI, Jetstream2, CyVerse, and MESA. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/partners/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/about/partners.md
- [Contributing to these docs](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/contributing/): How to edit pages, the OKF frontmatter contract, verifying migrated content, and building the site locally. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/contributing/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/about/contributing.md
- [For AI agents](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/ai-agents/): How agents and harnesses should consume this documentation: llms.txt, per-page Markdown with OKF frontmatter, raw source on GitHub, trust signals, and what to do if you cannot fetch this site. Markdown twin: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/ai-agents/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UNM-CARC/docs/main/docs/about/ai-agents.md

## Meta

- [Full corpus in one file](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with frontmatter, links made absolute; about 538 KB, roughly 138,000 tokens. Prefer it over fetching pages one at a time.
- [Documentation update log](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/log/): dated history of changes to this bundle.
- [For AI agents](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/ai-agents/): endpoints, trust signals, and how to answer questions from this corpus; includes what to do if you cannot fetch this site.
- [Sitemap](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/sitemap.xml) and [robots.txt](https://carc.unm.edu/docs/robots.txt).
- [Source repository](https://github.com/UNM-CARC/docs): the bundle itself; `docs/` mirrors the site paths one to one.
